text_block_list.text: I'm out for a walk when I hear a familiar voice beneath an overpass. I head down to check it out and find…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And I recommend using official light sticks! With generic ones, you run the risk of them being either too big or too bright!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Also, be careful not to wave them around too much or it can totally kill the mood!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Students
text_block_list.text: Okay! You really do know everything!
choice_data_list: What are you all up to?
What are you all up to?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! These middle schoolers asked me to teach them the finer points of enjoying a winning concert!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: We only just got into Umamusume racing, so we've got no idea what to do!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: We heard Digital's a master of all things fangirl, so we asked her to take us under her wing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All right, everyone, let's get back to training! Now, picture the venue in your heads…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Feel the unifying force of the concert! The feeling of not only you… but all the fans and all your faves celebrating together!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: R-right! When we wave our lights, we should sync our breathing with the people around us and create one giant wave!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Not just that, but when you're listening to the music, it's important that you listen with intent! I recommend that you watch some recordings of the songs to prep for the live experience!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: To… prep… Gulp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Next topic! Let's see, next up is…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Phew… I think that about covers all the basics. Sooo… how do you guys feel?

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: Whew… You really are amazing. It's like you've dedicated your whole life to this…

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, the two of us are total newbs…

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: We're not qualified to even go to a winning concert!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Qualified, hmmm… You know, it's not like I'm particularly qualified either.

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Not even with all your knowledge and experience?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Not in that way! What I'm saying is there's no such thing as being qualified!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All I want to do is come together with my oshis and the other fans to make a performance overflowing with love!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just love my faves—my oshis—with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: When simping, you don't need anything else. There are no special qualifications!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: Love… I wonder if we have it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Do you have it? It's practically gushing out of you.

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It took courage to come and talk to me. You have passion for concerts in your hearts… And all of that is love.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Knowing the two of you will be out there cheering on the Umas with me is just… the best feeling ever!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: We'll never forget our love for Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gwehehe… You two are up to your necks in the ocean that is Uma simping! ♪
choice_data_list: It looks like the hatchlings are ready to leave the nest.
From here on out, we can all enjoy the concerts as fellow fans!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's right. I think that's all I really have to teach… But honestly, you two were ready from the very start!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: There's no way that's true! But thanks to you, now we have the confidence to get out there!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: Next time we meet will definitely be at a concert! Um… I can't wait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Me too… I'm gonna deepen my own love for Umamusume even more!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's enjoy the otaku life together! …Hehehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital's smile seems a bit different after speaking with the kids.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooh, now there's one more thing to look forward to at concerts, huh? ♪

text_block_list.name: Middle School Boy
text_block_list.text: About that… Actually, I… I want to simp for you, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: Me too! Your sincere love for Umamusume is so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, um, mmm… Me?! You know there's plenty of Umamusume cuter than me out there, right?!

text_block_list.name: Middle School Girl
text_block_list.text: I love how humble you are too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-I-I… I'm really happy to hear that! But still! What do I do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital continues to squirm under the passionate gazes of her new fans!
